title: Polish Home run progress timeline
summary: Render the Home Run Progress panel as a grouped operator timeline while keeping backend progress DTOs and shared progress rendering unchanged.
reason: The existing Home progress panel displayed every progress row with identical visual weight, making active work, publish progress, and completed checks harder to scan during operator runs.
behavior_before: The Home Run Progress panel rendered progress bars as a flat shared list with long detail text under each bar.
behavior_after: The Home Run Progress panel groups progress into Active work, Publish, Subtitles, Completed, and Other checks with percent badges, compact status chips, accessible tracks, and wrapped metadata tokens.

rollback_plan: Restore Home renderProgressBars to delegate to renderProgressBarsInto, remove the progress-timeline CSS rules, and restore the prior Home live-state smoke text expectations.
notes: UI-only WebView rendering change. No Local API, backend DTO, route, command, media policy, queue, publish, rename, settings, source, scratch, or output behavior changed.
